items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: And whenever they had a good left hand they had Sonny. And he was that type of musician. He was well liked by everybody and I don't care wherever there was a party and he was always around.

ctx.x: And as a matter of fact you could always find good piano players with right hand. But whenever they had a good left hand they had Sonny. And he was that type of musician. He was well liked by everybody and I don't care wherever there was a party and he was always around. And I don't care who was playing piano, they had to get up and let Burnell play.
Now what type of musician was it? Did he read music? No he didn't read music. He was more or less gifted.
